note: The claimed value is the bare v1 digest of this preimage (no domain tag, no 'v2:' marker) presented as if it were a v2 action_ref. This is the exact collision class that motivated the v1->v2 split: SHA-256(JCS(preimage)) is a pure function of the four field values, so any other protocol that independently arrives at the same four-field JCS shape produces byte-identical output for the same underlying real-world event, with nothing in the hash itself to say which spec emitted it. A conformant v2 verifier must reject a claim that a bare, untagged 64-hex digest satisfies the v2 profile -- accepting it would mean action_ref alone can no longer prove which protocol's rules were applied.
